test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the theme of International day for Monuments and Sites, 2021?

options.text: Shared culture, Shared Heritage and Shared Responsibility

solution:
The correct answer is __**Complex pasts: Diverse Futures.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Heritage Day **

 
 
• World Heritage Day is celebrated every year on 18 April.
 
• Its aim is to preserve the human heritage and to recognize all the efforts of relevant organizations.
 
• The International Council on Monuments and Sites (ICOMOS) 1982 announced 18 April World Heritage Day.
 
• The aim of the day is to enhance awareness about the importance of cultural heritage, and monuments and conserving them.
 
• Complex Pasts: Diverse Futures was the theme of International day for Monuments and Sites i.e World Heritage Day 2021.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Heritage and Climate is the theme for **2022**.
 
• Shared Cultures, Shared Heritage and Shared Responsibility were the themes for World Heritage Day 2020.
 
• Rural Landscapes was the theme for World Heritage Day 2019
